reason: Critical logic and performance issues remain (double-counted purchases, ineffective initialization reuse, heavy I/O in counterfactuals, incomplete metrics). With two iterations left, a focused pass can fix these high-impact bugs, implement lightweight evaluation, and finalize metrics, significantly improving correctness and speed.

specific_areas: Fix purchase counter double-counting by using a single source of truth (event.purchases or derived from delta.mask_inventory, not both).

Add run() bootstrap when start_day>0 to ensure initialization happens if state is empty.
Guard all artifact writes behind artifacts_dir; use artifacts_dir=None for internal counterfactual and evaluation runs.
Implement Brier score as MSE between simulated and ground-truth adoption rates over common days; remove placeholder.
Correct gini() to use the filtered length after removing negatives.
Ensure stdout is clean (only final JSON); route diagnostics to stderr.
Add unit/integration tests for the above behaviors to prevent regressions.
